timeline.text: Man dies after reportedly being attacked by tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.
Yorkshire tiger attack ends in tragedy, but the zoo has no plans to put Altai down, reports say.
Man killed by tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park enclosure named as William Chapman, reports say.
Yorkshire Wildlife Park reopens and thanks visitors after fatal tiger attack, reports say.
